input_contract.encoding: Split and count raw main.log bytes before decoding a diagnostic; every allowed normalized diagnostic is ASCII.
input_contract.physical_line_definition: Split only on LF byte 0x0a. A physical-line width is its complete octet count excluding that LF and including every other byte, including leading or trailing HT, SP, or CR.
input_contract.scope: Reconstruct each pdflatex pass log independently before pass-scoped classification and counting.

continuation_precedence: Close immediately on one complete fullmatch before examining the next physical line.
If the next nonempty physical line is a new diagnostic start, fail the incomplete candidate and do not consume the new start.
If the current candidate is rerunfilecheck_outline_rerun and the next line matches the sole semantic-continuation grammar, retain one LF boundary.
Otherwise, only after an exact 79-byte preceding physical line, delete that one LF as a TeX hard wrap.
Every other attempted continuation is malformed and is a hard failure.
physical_log_dewrap.hard_wrap_join_action: Remove exactly the one LF boundary and concatenate the two physical-line byte strings unchanged; strip no byte and insert no byte.
hard_wrap_join_predicate: A recognized candidate is already open and does not yet fullmatch exactly one complete-event template.
The preceding physical line has exactly 79 octets excluding LF.
A following nonempty physical line exists.
The following physical line is neither a new diagnostic start nor the explicit rerunfilecheck semantic continuation.
physical_log_dewrap.independent_event_rule: A completed event never consumes lookahead. An incomplete event never crosses a physical line matching diagnostic_start_regex, including a start preceded only by HT or SP.

post_dewrap_event_normalization.rule: Collapse each nonempty run of ASCII whitespace bytes HT, LF, VT, FF, CR, and SP to one SP and trim only leading and trailing SP; make no other transformation.

required_shapes: an in-word hard wrap that literal whitespace collapse would render as in put
an in-word hard wrap that literal whitespace collapse would render as ex ist
a hard wrap immediately before a period that literal whitespace collapse would render with a space before the period
